name: living-canvas-trailer
logline: An idea becomes a world you walk through: a golden corridor of light in warm fog.

references.job: Camera path, speed, and blocking only.
references.exclude: its grey surfaces, flat lighting, or any visible geometry edges

references.job: Palette, material, and light: molten gold points and warm ember glow over near-black.

timeline.action: A single warm point of light breathes in darkness, then blooms into drifting golden dust.
The dust settles into luminous arches receding into warm fog; the camera glides through them.
The corridor opens onto a vast glowing diamond of light; everything slows to stillness.
timeline.camera: ease out to a gentle stop

camera: Follow @Video1's camera exactly — one continuous move, no cuts.
continuity: The golden particles are the same material throughout; one light source from upper left; fog color near-black warm brown.
audio: A low warm synth drone that swells as the arches appear, one soft glassy chime when the diamond is revealed.
constraints: no lens flares that cover the path
